name: Alexandria
overview: Alexandria is highlighted in Scripture as a significant city in Egypt, known as the birthplace of Apollos, a learned and powerful teacher of the Scriptures who came to Ephesus. The city also appears in the context of maritime activity, with ships of Alexandria playing a role in the travels of early believers, including the centurion’s journey to Italy and the departure after wintering on an island. Additionally, Alexandrians are noted among the diverse groups involved in disputes with Stephen, reflecting the city's Jewish diaspora presence in the early church.
